entries.title: Start with your Player Dashboard
entries.summary: Set your current HQ, review the single Next Best Action, and use local backup controls to resume your plan. LZ Carry does not connect to your game account.

sources.name: LZ Carry Player Dashboard
sources.note: Original interface walkthrough checked against the current published LZ Carry dashboard; no game mechanics or account data access are asserted.

entries.title: Plan your next HQ upgrade
entries.summary: Enter your current HQ, inspect the next building requirements, and mark only prerequisites you have confirmed in game. Use the calculator with current player-entered resource balances.

sources.name: LZ Carry HQ Upgrade Planner
sources.note: Original tool-use instructions reviewed against the published planner; the guide does not publish new upgrade costs or requirements.

entries.title: Track research without guessing
entries.summary: Search a research tree, open its prerequisites and evidence notes, and record progress only after checking your in-game Laboratory. Copy current resource costs into the calculator rather than relying on stale estimates.

sources.name: LZ Carry Research Center
sources.note: Original interface walkthrough checked against the current Research Center and Laboratory Planner; no unverified research costs are asserted.

entries.title: Estimate timer coverage with speedups
entries.summary: Enter the remaining timer and total speedup minutes you have available. The calculator performs time arithmetic only; confirm item restrictions and event rules in your live game.

sources.name: LZ Carry Speedup Planner
sources.note: Original tool-use instructions checked against the published player-entered timer calculator; no game-specific speedup item values or restrictions are assumed.
